post.description: Creates scored activities in Scoreboard Buzz in one request.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

input[].description: Array of activities to score in one request.

input[].userId.description: ID of the user to score the activity for.

input[].trackableId.description: ID of the trackable to score.

input[].productName.description: Optional product name for reference only.

input[].quantity.description: Number of units to score. Defaults to 1.

input[].value.description: Value amount to score. Defaults to 0.

deactivated.description: Whether the activity has been deactivated.
